note: chapter_title is "SUMMARY" rather than a chapter name. The input has no heading for the chapter opening (modes of excretion / ammonotelism, ureotelism, uricotelism); its surviving passage P01 covers only the survey of excretory structures, so subtopic 1 carries from_heading "unsure" and also holds the summary and exercise passages that deal with nitrogenous wastes across animals. Figure passages carry no text and were placed by position: P03 with the human excretory system, P06-P08 with nephron structure, P20 with tubule function, P23 with the counter current mechanism. SUMMARY passages (P36-P40) and the five exercise passages (P41-P45) were distributed to the subtopic whose content each one covers (e.g. P41 on GFR with subtopic 5, P45 on limb permeability and ADH with subtopic 8). The one-line disorder passages P34 and P35 were kept as their own subtopic rather than folded into uremia/dialysis, since both are separately named conditions.
